name: Scout Screen
intel: Light pressure. Deploy Guardian here to learn its movement and attack timing.

name: Bulwark Arrival
intel: Bulwark: a massive convoy leader with a 35% damage-reduction dome. Deploy Guardian to deal direct damage to it.

name: Hunter Ambush
intel: Viral Predator: hunts your Guardian directly. If Guardian is deployed, Hunters will chase it — Sniper can protect.

name: Shielded Push
intel: Bulwark + Shieldbearer + Healer convoy. Guardian neutralises Bulwark — towers handle the rest.

name: Command Convoy
intel: Hunters flank the convoy to target Guardian. Deploy late or with Sniper cover. Guardian + Slow = clear path.
